tooltip: Camera Mode – Allows you to select between HDR and Linear imaging modes
content1: Allows you to select the imaging mode of the camera. The camera supports two modes: HDR (High Dynamic Range) for enhanced detail in high-contrast scenes, and Linear mode for standard imaging.
content2:
CameraMode CU81 specifies the imaging mode:
  1. HDR (0x00) – High Dynamic Range mode for enhanced contrast and detail.
  2. LINEAR (0x01) – Standard linear imaging mode.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current camera imaging mode.
setAPIDes: This function sets the camera imaging mode.

tooltip: Special Effects – Allows you to apply special visual effects to the camera output
content1: Allows you to apply special visual effects to the camera output, including normal, black & white, greyscale, negative, and sketch modes.
content2:
SpecialEffectCU81 Enum indicates the specific effect to be applied:
  1. EFFECT_NORMAL (0x01) – No effect applied.
  2. EFFECT_BLACK_WHITE (0x04) – Black and white effect.
  3. EFFECT_GREYSCALE (0x07) – Greyscale effect.
  4. EFFECT_NEGATIVE (0x08) – Negative effect.
  5. EFFECT_SKETCH (0x10) – Sketch effect.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current special effect mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the special effect mode of the camera.

tooltip: Denoise Strength – Adjusts the noise reduction strength applied to the image
content1: Adjusts the level of noise reduction applied to the camera image. Higher values result in stronger noise reduction. The value ranges from 0 (no denoise) to 15 (maximum denoise).
content2:
1. getDenoiseValue retrieves the current denoise strength value.
2. setDenoiseValue sets the denoise strength (range: 0–15).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current denoise strength value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the denoise strength of the camera (range: 0–15).

tooltip: ROI Auto-Exposure – Configures the Region of Interest for auto-exposure
content1: Configures the Region of Interest (ROI) used by the auto-exposure system. The ROI can cover the full frame, a manually specified region, or be disabled.
content2:
1. ROIAutoExpModeCU81 Enum specifies the ROI auto-exposure mode:
   - AE_Full (0x01): Expose based on the full frame.
   - AE_Manual (0x02): Expose based on a manually specified region.
   - AE_Disabled (0x03): ROI-based auto-exposure is disabled.
2. ROIModeResult struct holds the current ROI mode and window size.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current ROI auto-exposure mode and window size.
setAPIHeading: bool setAutoExpROI(ROIAutoExpModeCU81 roiMode, uint32_t vidW, uint32_t vidH, uint32_t xCord, uint32_t yCord, uint8_t winSize)
setAPIDes: This function sets the ROI auto-exposure mode along with the video dimensions, coordinates, and window size.

tooltip: Image Capture (Burst Length) – Sets the number of images to capture in a single burst
content1: Sets the number of images the camera captures in a single burst. Values range from 1 to 5 images per burst.
content2:
1. getBurstLength retrieves the current burst length setting.
2. setBurstLength sets the burst length (range: 1–5).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current burst length value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the burst length (number of images per capture burst) of the camera.

tooltip: Q-Factor – Controls the JPEG compression quality factor of the camera
content1: Controls the JPEG compression quality factor of the camera output. A higher value results in better image quality with larger file sizes. The value ranges from 10 to 96.
content2:
1. getQFactor retrieves the current Q-Factor value.
2. setQFactor sets the Q-Factor value (range: 10–96).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current JPEG Q-Factor value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the JPEG Q-Factor of the camera (range: 10–96).

tooltip: Flip Control – Controls horizontal and vertical image flipping
content1: Controls the horizontal and/or vertical flipping of the camera image output. Both flip modes can be independently enabled or disabled.
content2:
FlipModeCU81 Enum specifies the flip configuration:
  1. BOTH_DISABLE (0x00): No flipping applied.
  2. HORZ_ONLY (0x01): Only horizontal flip is applied.
  3. VERT_ONLY (0x02): Only vertical flip is applied.
  4. BOTH_ENABLE (0x03): Both horizontal and vertical flips are applied.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current flip mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the horizontal and vertical flip modes of the camera independently.

tooltip: Exposure Compensation – Allows you to adjust the camera exposure compensation value
content1: Allows you to adjust the exposure compensation value of the camera to make the image brighter or darker. The value is specified in microseconds (us).
content2:
1. getExposureCompensation retrieves the current exposure compensation value.
2. setExposureCompensation sets the exposure compensation value (in microseconds).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current exposure compensation value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the exposure compensation value (in microseconds) of the camera.

tooltip: Frame Rate Control – Sets the frame rate of the camera stream
content1: Sets the frame rate (frames per second) of the camera stream. The frame rate can be configured from 1 to 120 fps.
content2:
1. getFrameRateCtrlValue retrieves the current frame rate setting.
2. setFrameRateCtrlValue sets the frame rate (range: 1–120 fps).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current frame rate control value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the frame rate of the camera stream (range: 1–120 fps).

tooltip: Face Detection – Enables or disables face detection with optional data embedding and overlay
content1: Enables or disables face detection on the camera stream. When enabled, options are available to embed detection metadata into the stream and to overlay a detection rectangle on the image.
content2:
FaceDetectResult struct holds the current face detection state:
  1. mode: Indicates whether face detection is enabled or disabled.
  2. embedData: Indicates whether face detection metadata is embedded in the stream.
  3. overlayRect: Indicates whether a rectangle is overlaid on detected faces.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current face detection mode, embed data state, and overlay rectangle state.
setAPIHeading: bool setFaceDetectRect(bool enable, bool embedData, bool overlayRect)
setAPIDes: This function enables or disables face detection and configures the embed data and overlay rectangle options.

tooltip: Current Auto-Exposure – Reads the current auto-exposure value from the camera
content1: Reads the current auto-exposure value from the camera in microseconds (us). This is a read-only control; the exposure value is automatically managed by the camera.
content2: 1. getAutoExposure retrieves the current auto-exposure value (in microseconds). This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses uint32_t parameter directly (read-only)
bool getAutoExposure(uint32_t &outExposure);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto-exposure value (in microseconds) from the camera.
setAPIDes: Current Auto-Exposure is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Auto Exposure.
// Use getAutoExposure() to read the current value.

tooltip: Auto White-Balance – Reads the current auto white balance value from the camera
content1: Reads the current auto white balance value from the camera in Kelvin. This is a read-only control; the white balance value is automatically managed by the camera.
content2: 1. getAutoWhiteBalance retrieves the current auto white balance value (in Kelvin). This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses uint16_t parameter directly (read-only)
bool getAutoWhiteBalance(uint16_t &outAWB);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current auto white balance value (in Kelvin) from the camera.
setAPIDes: Auto White Balance is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Auto White Balance.
// Use getAutoWhiteBalance() to read the current value.

tooltip: Anti-Flicker Mode – Configures the anti-flicker mode to reduce banding under artificial lighting
content1: Configures the anti-flicker mode to reduce image banding caused by artificial lighting. The mode can be set to auto-detect the frequency, manually set to 50 Hz or 60 Hz, or disabled.
content2:
FlickerModeCU81 Enum specifies the anti-flicker mode:
  1. MODE_DISABLE (0x00): Anti-flicker is disabled.
  2. MODE_AUTO (0x01): Automatically detects and compensates for flicker.
  3. MODE_50Hz (0x02): Compensates for 50 Hz power line frequency (common in Europe/Asia).
  4. MODE_60Hz (0x03): Compensates for 60 Hz power line frequency (common in North America).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current anti-flicker mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the anti-flicker mode of the camera.

tooltip: Serial Number – Reads the 64-bit serial number of the camera
content1: Reads the unique 64-bit serial number of the camera device. This is a read-only property used for device identification.
content2: 1. get64BitSerialNumber retrieves the 64-bit serial number of the camera. This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses uint64_t parameter directly (read-only)
bool get64BitSerialNumber(uint64_t &outSerial);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the 64-bit unique serial number of the camera.
setAPIDes: Serial Number is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Serial Number.
// Use get64BitSerialNumber() to read the device serial number.

tooltip: Firmware Version – Reads the firmware version string of the camera
content1: Reads the firmware version string from the camera. This is a read-only property used to identify the firmware currently running on the device.
content2: 1. readFirmwareVersion retrieves the firmware version as a string. This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses std::string parameter directly (read-only)
bool readFirmwareVersion(std::string &version);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the firmware version string from the camera.
setAPIDes: Firmware Version is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Firmware Version.
// Use readFirmwareVersion() to read the current firmware version.

tooltip: Set to Default – Resets all camera settings to factory defaults
content1: Resets all camera controls and settings to their factory default values.
content2: 1. setToDefault resets all camera properties to their default factory values.
getAPIDes: Set to Default is a write-only action. There is no get function for this operation.
getAPICode:
// No get API available for Set to Default.
// Use setToDefault() to reset the camera to factory settings.
setAPIDes: This function resets all camera properties to their factory default values.

tooltip: Default Configuration – Resets camera configuration to factory defaults
content1: Resets the camera configuration to factory default settings. This is similar to Set to Default and restores the camera to its original state.
content2: 1. setDefaultConfig resets the camera configuration to factory defaults.
getAPIDes: Default Configuration is a write-only action. There is no get function for this operation.
getAPICode:
// No get API available for Default Configuration.
// Use setDefaultConfig() to restore the camera to factory settings.
setAPIDes: This function resets the camera configuration to factory default settings.

tooltip: Save Configuration – Saves the current camera settings to persistent storage
content1: Saves the current camera control settings to the camera's persistent storage so they are retained after power cycling.
content2: 1. saveConfiguration persists the current camera settings to non-volatile memory.
getAPIDes: Save Configuration is a write-only action. There is no get function for this operation.
getAPICode:
// No get API available for Save Configuration.
// Use saveConfiguration() to persist current camera settings.
setAPIDes: This function saves the current camera configuration to persistent storage.
